parent_objective: design an instrumented rerun of the M1693 public workload
blocked_by: need design before rerunning the 864-cell workload with outcome semantics instrumentation
supersedes: controller-family ranking from uninstrumented M1693 rows

public_gates: M1697 must design but not execute the instrumented 864-cell public rerun
M1697 must preserve the exact M1693 workload, profiles, checkpoints, seeds, and actor input contract
M1697 must require outcome, termination-reason, and profile-outcome aggregates
M1697 must keep no-training no-replay no-PPO no-promotion no-private-holdout guardrails
M1697 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID
forbidden_shortcuts: do not execute the full rerun in M1697

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the rerun needed to audit outcome semantics after M1696 instrumentation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: rerun design only; no full rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if rerun would change workload, profiles, checkpoints, or seeds
stop if rerun would change actor inputs
stop if required outcome aggregates are missing
stop if design permits direct ranking before audit
fallback_plan: route to instrumented rerun execution if design is complete
route to instrumentation repair if schema gaps remain
route to branch synthesis if the current workload is unsuitable
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1696 implementation passes and admits an instrumented rerun design

admission_evidence: M1696 implements logging-only outcome semantics and passes focused tests
blocked_shortcuts: do not execute full rerun in M1697
do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1697 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up instrumented rerun execution manifest
next_stage_criteria: rerun command and artifacts are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1697 is rerun design and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset comparison rows for later audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If instrumented rerun still shows reset/current-tiled controls matching history profiles, record that as a history-necessity gap.
allowed_claims: no full rollout in M1697, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A guarded instrumented rerun plan can preserve M1693 comparability while adding outcome semantics needed for later audit.
success_criteria: design specifies same 864 workload and deterministic seeds
full rerun training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design changes workload profiles checkpoints seeds or actor inputs
full rerun training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: design
commands.command: write instrumented rerun design without executing full rollout

decision_rule: M1697 passes if it writes a complete instrumented rerun design and routes to a separate execution manifest without overclaiming.
